<script setup lang="ts" generic="Value, Multiple extends boolean | undefined = false, Item = Value">
import type { ComboboxRootEmits, ComboboxRootProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import { Combobox } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ ComboboxRootProps<Value, Multiple, Item> {}
interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ ComboboxRootEmits<Value, Multiple> {}

defineProps<Props>()
defineEmits<Emits>()
</script>

<template>
  <Combobox.Root data-slot="combobox">
    <slot />
  </Combobox.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps<{
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}>()
</script>

<template>
  <Combobox.InputGroup
    data-slot="combobox-anchor"
    :class="cn('', props.class)"

    :class="cn('text-muted-foreground hidden w-full justify-center py-2 text-center text-sm group-data-empty/combobox-content:flex', props.class)"

<script setup lang="ts">

</script>

<template>
  <Combobox.Group
    data-slot="combobox-group"

    <Combobox.GroupLabel v-if="heading" class="text-muted-foreground px-2 py-1.5 text-xs">

    </Combobox.GroupLabel>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ComboboxInputProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'

import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { SearchIcon } from '@lucide/vue'

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = defineProps<Props>()
</script>

<template>
  <InputGroup class="w-auto">
    <InputGroupAddon>
      <SearchIcon class="size-4 shrink-0 opacity-50" />
    </InputGroupAddon>
    <Combobox.Input
      data-slot="combobox-input"
      :class="cn('flex-1 outline-hidden disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50', props.class)"
      v-bind="$attrs"
    />
  </InputGroup>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ComboboxItemProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Combobox } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ ComboboxItemProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
</script>

<template>
  <Combobox.Item
    data-slot="combobox-item"
    :class="cn('data-highlighted:bg-accent data-highlighted:text-accent-foreground not-data-[variant=destructive]:data-highlighted:**:text-accent-foreground gap-2 rounded-md py-1 pr-8 pl-1.5 text-sm [&_svg:not([class*=size-])]:size-4 group/combobox-item relative flex w-full cursor-default items-center outline-hidden select-none aria-disabled:pointer-events-none aria-disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </Combobox.Item>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ComboboxPopupProps, ComboboxPositionerProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Combobox } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ ComboboxPopupProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  side?: ComboboxPositionerProps['side']
  sideOffset?: ComboboxPositionerProps['sideOffset']
  align?: ComboboxPositionerProps['align']
  alignOffset?: ComboboxPositionerProps['alignOffset']
}

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  side: 'bottom',
  sideOffset: 4,
  align: 'center',
  alignOffset: 0,
})

function onBeforeEnter(el: Element) {
  el.removeAttribute('data-closed')
  el.setAttribute('data-open', '')
}

function onBeforeLeave(el: Element) {
  el.removeAttribute('data-open')
  el.setAttribute('data-closed', '')
}
</script>

<template>
  <Combobox.Portal>
    <Combobox.Positioner
      :side="side"
      :side-offset="sideOffset"
      :align="align"
      :align-offset="alignOffset"
      class="isolate z-50"
    >
      <Transition @before-enter="onBeforeEnter" @before-leave="onBeforeLeave">
        <Combobox.Popup
          data-slot="combobox-content"
          v-bind="$attrs"
          :class="cn('bg-popover text-popover-foreground data-open:animate-in data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2 ring-foreground/10 *:data-[slot=input-group]:bg-input/30 *:data-[slot=input-group]:border-input/30 overflow-hidden rounded-lg shadow-md ring-1 duration-100 *:data-[slot=input-group]:m-1 *:data-[slot=input-group]:mb-0 *:data-[slot=input-group]:h-8 *:data-[slot=input-group]:shadow-none data-[side=inline-start]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=inline-end]:slide-in-from-left-2 cn-menu-target cn-menu-translucent group/combobox-content relative z-50 max-h-(--available-height) w-(--anchor-width) max-w-(--available-width) min-w-[calc(var(--anchor-width)+--spacing(7))] origin-(--transform-origin)', props.class)"
        >
          <slot />
        </Combobox.Popup>
      </Transition>
    </Combobox.Positioner>
  </Combobox.Portal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ComboboxSeparatorProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Combobox } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ ComboboxSeparatorProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
</script>

<template>
  <Combobox.Separator
    data-slot="combobox-separator"
    :class="cn('bg-border -mx-1 my-1 h-px', props.class)"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ComboboxTriggerProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Combobox } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { computed, useTemplateRef } from 'vue'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ ComboboxTriggerProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()

const part = useTemplateRef<{ element: Element | null }>('part')
// An outer trigger that renders this wrapper in its element slot reads the element of the part.
defineExpose({ element: computed(() => part.value?.element ?? null) })
</script>

<template>
  <Combobox.Trigger
    ref="part"
    data-slot="combobox-trigger"
    :class="cn('[&_svg:not([class*=size-])]:size-4', props.class)"
  >
    <template v-if="$slots.element" #element="slotProps">
      <slot name="element" v-bind="slotProps" />
    </template>
    <slot />
  </Combobox.Trigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ComboboxListProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Combobox } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ ComboboxListProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
</script>

<template>
  <Combobox.List
    data-slot="combobox-viewport"
    :class="cn('no-scrollbar max-h-[min(calc(--spacing(72)---spacing(9)),calc(var(--available-height)---spacing(9)))] scroll-py-1 overflow-y-auto p-1 data-empty:p-0', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
    <template v-if="$slots.item" #item="slotProps">
      <slot name="item" v-bind="slotProps" />
    </template>
  </Combobox.List>
</template>

import { Combobox as VaseCombobox } from '@vase-ui/vue/combobox'

export { default as Combobox } from './Combobox.vue'
export { default as ComboboxAnchor } from './ComboboxAnchor.vue'
export { default as ComboboxEmpty } from './ComboboxEmpty.vue'
export { default as ComboboxGroup } from './ComboboxGroup.vue'
export { default as ComboboxInput } from './ComboboxInput.vue'
export { default as ComboboxItem } from './ComboboxItem.vue'
export { default as ComboboxItemIndicator } from './ComboboxItemIndicator.vue'
export { default as ComboboxList } from './ComboboxList.vue'
export { default as ComboboxSeparator } from './ComboboxSeparator.vue'
export { default as ComboboxTrigger } from './ComboboxTrigger.vue'
export { default as ComboboxViewport } from './ComboboxViewport.vue'

export const ComboboxCancel = VaseCombobox.Clear
